data.text: I found this recipe last night and had to make it today!  Halved the recipe because didn't have a large pan.  I used  a 1/2 cup of chocolate chips.  I checked them at 7 minutes, turned off the oven, left them in another 3 but they burned a little on the edges so maybe 10 minutes too long?  (Burned sugar is bitter- ick.)  Overall good though.  Interesting new treat!  Thank you.

This was an AMAZING salad.  The variety of ingredients was very different from typical salad fare.  I have never had Smokey Bones salad, but I can highly recommend this AND the dressing the chef includes.  I could eat this for every meal.  We have little kids, so the second time I made it (3 times in one week, that is how much I like this), I left out the wasabi peas (too HOT), and the sesame sticks.  I couldn't find small sesame sticks, and the Keeblers that I found were too big, and added too much salt to the salad.  Definitely serve for company.  Expect compliments!

Once the pandemic hit, I started baking bread again, and needed an everyday sandwich loaf. After trying a few recipes and ending up with bland, flavorless loaves, I found this recipe and everything changed. Thank you for it! I bake 2 loaves every weekend, and today am turning one loaf into cinnamon raisin bread.

My mom actually passed this recipe along to me, and now it's a new-classic in our family.  We make it for Passover and Chanukah and any gathering that calls for great quantities of delicious beefy goodness!  

What we do, however, is make it the day before we want to serve it, let it chill overnight, then scrape off the solidified fat from the juices, slice off the fat cap, slice the beef and then return it all to the pan, covered, to reheat for the evening's festivities.  It makes for a much more relaxed meal.

Go to a good deli and get GOOD chorizo! Not mexican! YOu want good european chorizo. Has flavor. Used only 1/4 pound kale, as had kids eating and that was almost too much for them to handle. green floaties!!

I made this recipe two days in a row! My very picky family LOVED it!! Its so easy and the end result is so delicious! Thank you for the recipe, I know I'll use it for years to come... one thing I did different was to add nutmeg when I added the cinnamon over the apples
I loved this recipe especially for Christmas because of the colors. I added walnuts to mine and thought it was a great addition.

Fantastic !! My husband couldn't believe that there was not meat inside !! He normally doesn't even like eggplant ...ah ah
Thanks so much for sharing

This is a wonderful lip balm. My lips feel so soft after using this. I just made another batch for a friend and I'm sure she'll love it just as much as I did. Thank You for the recipe! Special thanks to Uncle Miller for sending me a bottle of peppermint extract, without which I wouldn't be able to make this.

This recipe goes straight into the regular rotation of soups I make for my family of soup lovers. It's quick and easy, versatile and fabulous. I made a couple of changes. I used 3/4 lb of italian hot sausage and no ground beef, regular canned tomatoes, and one can of black beans and one can of chili beans. It turned out full of flavour and nice and spicy. Thank you, Fluffster.
This is an excellent recipe.  Had it for lunch and I really enjoyed it.  Thanks Karyl Lee.

I baked this in an 8x8 pan for 1 hour and topped it with 1/2 cup pecams. I placed tin foil lightly over the top to keep the pecans from burning. Mine was a little crumbly so I'm looking at increasing the butter to 1 cup. Also, like another reviewer, I'll try a bigger pan to get them thinner. I also upped the cinnamon to 1t and added 1/2 t nutmed and 1/4t cloves. My BF was hit with the scent when he can home and said it was great. For me, more of a crumble than a bar. You have to let this sit overnight to be able to cut  it but still a fabulous recipe.
Nice variant of minestrone! I've cooked it in our Redmond (multi cooker) - the family liked it! Perfect healthy soup on cold winter day

I've subbed bagged shredded cabbage for fresh(cole slaw mix) & used light sour cream, with great results.  (I've tried using 2% shredded cheese, but it doesn't get as creamy.)  This is recipe is always a hit, especially for those on low carb diets or trying to feed diabetics.  My family couldn't believe the "noodles" were cooked cabbage.

Great recipe!  I used it on a steak that I marinated for 3 hours and then grilled.  It filled the house with a wonderful aroma, and it turned out perfect!  "Greek Night" will definetely be happening again!

Because of the rain today I had to bake rather than grill the chicken. But otherwise made as directed. The skin was nice and crispy and the meat was very tender. We would have liked more spices, herbs, and perhaps melted butter rather than olive oil or a blend of the two. Overall a nice recipe, just needs more flavor. Thanks for sharing. :)

This may be my new favorite dish! My husband prepared this recipe last night. He used crimini mushrooms which gave it nice color and an earthy flavor. So simple and yet so elegant! This one is a keeper...and so is the recipe!
An authentic recipe which we very much enjoyed. I was unable to obtain galangal so used fresh ginger root as a substitute.  Thanks Latchy, I will use this again and again.

Cooking the garlic prior to adding the cabbage mellows out the garlic and makes it perfect with the cabbage.  I did cook my cabbage a few minutes longer than called for.  I am with Parsley, I will make this one again.

We had this 'as is', not as a sandwich.. great combination of flavors.. have made this many times, its worth the repeat, my kids ALL love this. Like another reviewer suggested, I pre-prepped this -  I grill these on the George Foreman, build it, then fix the rest of dinner.. finally broil when we're ready. Great tip!
Easy to make, easier to eat!  Great crumb that held together well and stayed moist, even the next day.  Thanks for posting!

oooh, so good! I used half brandy, half OJ. I used readymade christmas pudding, so it was a little sticky, but I put them in red and green mini cupcake foil papers, which solved the sticking-to-the-sheet problem and looks so cute!
I followed the recipe exactly. My family and I just didn't care for it. For us something was missing...can't figure out what.

I have made these twice and noticed my original review did not post.  As you might gather, we loved these. The meat was bursting with flavor and all the seasonings were in just the right amounts. I was a little worried about the parsley but it was perfect.  I served mine on low point buns and used the saved point to add a slice of soy mozzarella.  A couple of slices of fresh tomatoes and it was a perfect main dish. Thanks mariposa.

I admit I had to change the recipe a bit, but my roll-ups came out delicious!  I had to use turkey breast and used lavash flatbread instead of tortillas.  We loved the combination of flavors and will definitely keep this in my recipebook. I liked the barbecue/salsa combination with the avocado and sundried tomatoes! Thank you MadszMom!
Thanks so much for this...  love both flavors and never thought to combine them...  Quick, easy and so yummy!
Good Stuff. The best. My wife begs me to make it for her.

I have an Indian friend who made this dish for my family.  This recipe tastes almost like it, but I think some of the proportions for the spices is off.  I definitely think it calls for too much saffron (my rice was too yellow).  I think it should be just a pinch.  I will definitely try it again, but will probably tweak it!

WOW! I've never made anything quite like this before.  I made it for Saturday morning brunch and my family loved it.  The only thing I did different was not put the hash browns in it and just cooked them on the side(that's the way my hubby wanted them).  It turned out just wonderful.  Very easy to make and very tasty.  Thanks!

I made this for my husband's birthday. I really didn't think I'd like it because I'm not much of thai food fan. Wow! Was I wrong! The flavor is out of this world. We ate the whole thing in one night. Yummy!
Delicious way to serve mashed potatoes.  Comfort food at its best.  I didn't use a whole cup of cream though.  More like 1/3 cup.  Made for Aussie / Kiwi Swap May 2010

Absolutely amazing!!  A flavor explosion in your mouth!  Didn't have time to let the frosting chill before glazing so I just marbled the glaze into the frosting and let it chill overnight.  I didn't add walnuts but did use the espresso powder and think it's worth trying to find.  Made it for a dinner party and cut into small squares, but everyone kept going back for more.

I used tuna to make my patties.  Boy was it quick and easy!  I loved the taste of the dill and lime together.  They were so pretty too.  How unusual to use corn flakes as the "crunch" in this dish.  We have no leftovers,  as my husband finished them off.  Thanks, twissis.  I will be making these again.
This was a fantastic dish! My family loved it. I would recommend to cook the chicken for 30 minutes and add toppings the last 10 minutes of baking time. I would definitely make this dish again.

Your recipes never disappoint, ratherbe! I couldn't get my family to leave me alone while I was making this last night...the house smelled like an italian bistro and the end result is deeeeeeeeelish! Can't wait to try the leftovers. Thanks!
This was superb, made and added to Crockpot Round Steak #9029. The combination was great. I will make this often and will save money by making my own instead of purchasing ready made from the store.
I love this recipe and can't believe I haven't rated this yet!  I could eat this for breakfast, lunch, and dinner...it is SOOO good!

This is the best recipe ever.  My whole family loved it.  Had it after dinner tonite for dessert.  Just put a few Tablespoons of vanilla ice cream on top and let it melt on it just a bit.  I think you could use just about any apple in this recipe.  I also had to bake it for about 45-50 mins in an 8x8 pan.  Just keep an eye on it and check it like you would with any other cake.  I also used apple pie spice with the sugar.

I am going through a bit of a butter sauce phase so I enjoyed the opportunity to make this. The olive oil stops the butter sauce from burning.
Don't add salt if your butter is salted.
Good lunch dish and it was also popular with my 3 year old.
This was delicious! I halved the recipe and it was more than enough to ice 12 cupcakes. Thanks for posting!

I love this recipe and I'll be making it often. It was kind of fun to make and it was so easy. I used 1 teaspoon of the crushed red pepper and the spiciness was just right for me. Thanks for posting your fabulous recipe.
Loved this dip.  I added 3 tablespoons of maraschino cherry juice that I needed to use up.  Served with both fruit and sugar cookies.

I made this for a large BBQ that served about 60 people. It was amazing! I got so many compliments! The French dressing is the best! I will be making this again very soon for a family reunion coming up! I did have a lot of leftovers and I did not add the spiral pasta because I didn't have it on hand!

Sorry, but this is just not for me and my family. 
We are changing to healthy eating and decided that carrots and salad are far better.
I followed the directions exactly and the results were just not good.

loved these apples, they turned out really lovely. I got a bit happy with and made 9. with double the quantity. They went down a treat... especially with chai tea. I used walnuts instead of pecans as it was  all I had in the house.

This is fantastic! I have made it for 2 different groups of people and both have raved about it!

I made exactly like the recipe said.. (but forgot the lemon both times)

Thank you!
A nice change of pace! We liked the chewy texture but did not like how soupy it was. I made as written and will cut back the milk some next time. Thanks for the post.

These were wonderful! The flavor of the pork is great. The hardest part of the recipe is trimming the fat off the pork and cubing it. I baked mine for about 12 minutes so it didn't dry out too much. Made the house smell so good. Thank you for posting!

I've made these a few times and they are yummy. The only problem is that Guittard had discontinues the cappuccino chips. I bought a few bags before they were all gone.
Mimi

Taste was good, but couldn't find weight watchers bread anywhere, so just used white bread (low cal).  Very mushy inside. Any ideas on how to change this?  I used egg beaters and skim milk. Very disappointed.

Lovely dish! Made this with gluten free flour, and it turned out great. Easy to make and very tasty. recipe #504455 was the perfect addition. Thanks for sharing :)
Made for ZWT 9 / Scandinavia for The Apron String Travelers

These were very good Lori!  I had 3 bonless chops and what I thought were chops turned out to be tenderloin pieces.  I slow cooked them all on the grill then basted them.  Watch when basting as it will burn with all the brown sugar.  The sauce is great, we had it with mashed potatoes.  The leftovers sat in the fridge with the sauce and the longer they sat the better they got!  We had the leftovers chopped up and stir fried with some rice for a quick lunch.  I think that next time I make these I will make the sauce without cooking it and marinade the chops in it for an hour then cook the chops and boil the sauce.  Thanks for a awesome recipe.

We *really* enjoyed this! I forgot to presoak my beans so I quick-soaked them and then made this on the stove top. I sauteed the onions, garlic, and ginger before throwing everything else in. It cooked in about 2 hours. If I had soaked the beans longer, it might've taken less. At first I forgot the lime, it was great without it but even better when I added it! I froze the leftovers and will update you when I use them.

This was awesome!!! I didn''t have any dry sherry so I left it out.I also left out the thai peppers (I have small children) and sprinkled dry red pepper flakes on whom ever wanted at the table. I used onions, red pepper, mushrooms, carrot, brocolli and celery and served it over chinese noodles. YUM YUM YUM!!!
 I also added two cloves of garlic when stir frying my veggies.
Interesting... a little odd ... but not too bad. I skipped the nutritional yeast 'cause, I don't like it. Reviewed for ZWT3

Tasted Great and so  easy to make.   I omitted the cream of celery and the french onion soup and instead used 1 can of beef broth and a 1 cup of sherry.  I also used 2 cans of the golden mushroom soup and added about 1 tablespoon minced garlic.  It was delicious and tasted as good as my moms (who in my opinion makes the best beef stroganoff)  Thanks for the crockpot recipe!   I will definitely be making this one again and again!

Okay.. These are AMAZING!  I love Starbucks anything... so I had to make these.  I have made scones before, so I just used my usual method: I mixed everything in my food processor in the order listed and I made these for work, so I wanted more than 8.  I formed the dough into a rectangle and cut it into 3 squares, then cut the squares into 2 triangles each, then cut the triangles into 2 smaller triangles.  This gave me 12 mini scones and they were inhaled within about 20 minutes at work!  Thanks for posting!  Made for ZWT 4.

These were excellent!  I thought the taste was wonderful and they looked beautiful.  The dough was so easy to work with and rose just fine for me.  I served these as part of my Thanksgiving meal and everyone commented on how light and fluffy these rolls were.  Delicious!NOTE: I did knead the dough a bit before refrigerating it, even though the instructions didn't mention kneading.
Very easy to make. My (very picky,) husband LOVED IT, my step-son said it was good but only ate until the tots were gone leaving the remaining meat, I thought it was "O-K".

I marinated a tri tip yesterday with this marinade.  It turned out nicely and there was plenty of marinade to do the trick.  I did add garlic, but kept the rest the same.  I will fix this again.  Thank CoreyAnn for posting your father's recipe.

Couldn't bring myself to peel the potatoes, & I was generous with the amount of crumbs, but other than those two things, I pretty much followed the recipe & found this side dish wonderfully tasty! Definitely a recipe I'll be keeping around, & am thinking of having these potatoes several times during the end-of-year holiday season! Thanks for sharing the recipe! [Made & reviewed in the Almost 5 Special Event]

You were not lying! These are the best we've ever had. I tripled a couple times and made a huge batch for a hungry crew of teens. Rave reviews! And none left-over! I did snag a couple to taste, but that's all I got. Will definately be making again and again..Thanks for posting! :)

I made this New Years day for my family.  We all really enjoyed it.  We even had it the next day chips and cheese style.  I tripled the recipe so that we would have left overs to freeze for a later time.  I would definatly make this one again.  It was a winner in my opinion!!  Thank you.

THESE ARE AMAZING!
Everytime we serve them everyone is beyond impressed!
THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU!
fantastic.  chop was tender and not overcooked.  sauce was delicious.  served with asparagus cooked in oven with olive oil, salt & pepper, and then browned butter atop.
Wow!! So easy to make and so delicious!!  I can't stop eating it!  I doubled the recipe.  This is supposed to be saved for Christmas but I just may need to make another batch!
Perfect every time.  Light and very easy to make. Have added 1TB sugar and 1 tsp of vanilla for a sweet variation and my family loves it both ways.
Absolutely delicious - thanks for the perfect cold weather treat!
Made with butterfly chops.  Added fresh mushrooms.  My family loved it.  Simple, tasty, quick and easy.  Will definitely make again.

The name says it all!!
   Hubby made this dish following recipe exactly,we did use fresh flat leaf italian parsley and fresh chopped basil for the italian seasoning before topping with provolone cheese.this was indeed simplicity at it's best..he served this with buttered egg noodles and left over fresh green beans..
  Veryyyyy Yummyyyy   
    Thanks for a super fast super delicious recipe!!!
   Debbie
Add some chicken and cooked bacon for a something a little different - delicious!

This method definitely works. It's my go-to every time. Occasionally I'll replace some of the water with chicken or beef broth if I have one already opened. That's an excellent way to boost the flavor of the brown rice.
This was a very nice recipe for garlic bread.  Only complaint was that mine was not done, even at 20 minutes.  Will try again but definitely needs more cooking time.

This was an easy recipe to put together.  I used fresh broccoli and sauted it with the chicken (after it was 3/4 cooked) and some teriyaki sauce as another reviewer suggested, it added very nice flavor.  I also added some paprika and sage to the chicken, also very good.  A nice recipe, thanks Hey Jude!

Easy and delicious! I had all of the ingredients on hand except for the gluten-free breadcrumbs, so I used panko in its place. My whole family really enjoyed this crispy and flavorful chicken. I loved that it was pretty darn healthy. The parmesan, paprika and parsley give nice flavoring, while keeping it simple. I'm keeping this in my file for those nights when I want a quick dinner that will satisfy everyone. Thank you! ~Made for Oct. Aussie/NZ Swap~

Very nice sauce and the meat was tender.  I threw in potatoes and carrots and found that I needed a bit more liquid so I added a bit of broth about half way through the cooking. A nice change from my usual pot roast.

I made his cake as directed, except that when it was time to assemble it, the whole thing was just too tall to do in one cake. So I just made it into two cakes, using half the cream on each one.  Still, it was very good, and much appreciated by my guests and family alike.

... Apologies but I fried the onions in Olive Oil and Butter until just translucent and the followed with the rest of the ingredients with a touch of water the righty side of soft mixed .. chicken was precooked bought (tempus fugit) but drumstick a la BBQ Sugar etc... I mixed the mayonnaise only  on serving just to better keep the unused  chicken mix until Anon.. Inspired Menu and reminiscent of Other South African Stews... simple and subtle and will go with any (cold) left over Curries.. L&K.Mmy,Me,TU&Apricot

I made this for my lunch and it was DELICIOUS.  Thank you very much! It was a bit of work and I was afraid that it would turn out too salty because of all the salt I added in the beginning, but it came out just right.  My cooked eggplant must have been too watery since I needed almost 2 cups of breadcrumbs for them.  They were still very light, savory, and delicious... thanks!

Great recipe! Although, I made a few adjustments, I used vegetable broth, vegan sausage and 1/2 hilshire farms spicy sausage. My husband didn’t even notice it had vegan sausage. It was a hit! Thank you!

We had this for brunch.  Used 1/2 pineapple juice and 1/2 orange juice because I ran out of orange, and it turned out great.  Has a nice citrus flavor - mild enough to not scare the kids, flavorful enough to please the adults.  Thanks for a great recipe!

This turned out great. We used vegan mayonnaise instead of miracle whip, but it still tasted like Olive Garden's recipe to us. Also, we used 1 garlic clove instead of 1/4 teaspoon of garlic salt. If you are not a garlic lover, that may turn you off quite a bit (my parents were over for supper and they didn't even touch this dressing on the table because it smelled too much like garlic).

We had unexpected company come by this afternoon I had "jerked" the pork the night before and made the salsa this morning before going to the dentist. I ask them to stay for supper and had DH grill the pork. I have to tell you that I skipped the hot pepper altogether and used powdered ginger as that was all I had. Everyone was mmmmm'ing away while I had my soup. Even the neighbor was sniffing the breeze that was drifting her way. There are a lot of ingredients but once the chopping is done it's straight forward and no hassle. The guests took home leftovers with a smile.

I made this into twelve regular size muffins instead of a cake. I used regular plain yogurt since that is what I had on had. That made them higher in fat content, but they were so good warm with a glass of milk. My muffins were done in about 16 - 17 minutes. Next time I will add a bit more cinnamon-personal preference- and perhaps a few pecans, walnuts or raisins. This recipe is a keeper!
Fantastic! My husband, who doles out compliments rarely, if ever, complimented me on this without prompting!
This is an amazing recipe.. Just add a little cinnamon and put it in cupcake containers(350* for 12-20 minutes) it makes a great gift, or something to have for dessert.

We liked this just fine but my family said it didn't taste like stroganov.  It had a creamy tomato flavor which made it taste more like a tomato soup than stroganov.  It could use some more spices to give it more flavor and with the long cook time it's just not a must make for my family.  Oh, I did cook it for 1 1/2 hours and the beef was tender.

These are super delicious even if i screwed up :D I split the serving size in half but forgot to split the egg because it seems too messy and i also forgot to fork cross it down so i zapped it in the microwave for 2 minutes until the centers were done and they came out perfect and my boyfriend had them for breakfast :p lol

This was very good. We enjoyed it over brown rice. I really liked the fact that the sauce stayed thick and not watery.  I used just peas and had to use celery seed instead of celery salt.  I also added just a little garlic powder.

This is an awesome, yummy and speedy recipe!! My family loves it!! We even made sub sandwiches with the meatballs. Made it twice already within a few weeks!! Thank you so much for sharing this recipe.

My husband, 2 sons (10 and 8), and I thought these were really good!  I followed the directions exactly.  They would taste bland if eaten alone, but once you add the powdered sugar, they are great!  My husband thought they tasted better than the ones from our state fair.  I definitely agree with one post about NOT using water to test the oil.  It splatters like crazy.  Also, using a funnel does not work.  As with another post, I used a ziploc bag with one corner sniped- worked like a charm!  We will definitely make them again!

I made this with my mom and I thought it was going to be really hard to make but it ended up being so easy. I recommend this for anyone who is bad at cooking but needs a task mean. So easy nutritious and al around great.
These were a hit with the whole family.  I used splenda instead of sugar and an 8X8 for 28 min.  They were more cakey than brownie but still good.

Loved these very simple cookies that used my favourite ingredient of ground almonds and were gluten-free suitable too. A delicious cookie that I will make again. Reviewed for Make my Recipe Tag Game in the Aus/NZ forum (a very late tag - my apologies for taking so long to review your recipe). Photo also to be posted

My problem eater scarfed this up and asked for more, and I've rated it on that basis. For me, this was a little bland. I used skirt steak, which was excellent and in my area less than half the price of flank steak. I think next time I'll wait to put the green onion tops until the very end, and also add a little more fresh ginger, possibly some red pepper flakes. Also, I have a small crockpot and this amount barely filled it up halfway. It was quite tender after 4 1/2 hrs. If you have a larger crockpot, you will really want to watch the time. The bean sprouts did not look great, so I subbed spinach, which worked beautifully.  Definitely a recipe worth playing around with again.

These were tender, moist and bursting with flavor.  It really elevated the ground turkey to a whole new level.  My whole family enjoyed these, including my 2 and 3 year old sons.  I baked them at 350 for 25 minutes like another reviewer did and they turned out perfectly as well.  I then added them to my marinara sauce and cooked for a couple more minutes.  DELICIOUS!
Awesome recipe!  I made it for Easter dinner and everyone loved it.  Goes great with ham and cheesy potatoes!  Will make this again for light summer dinner with grilled meats.

Wonderful flavor!  Added 2 cloves of chopped garlic as well, shredded the chicken and served over home-made mashed potatoes.  Will try egg noodles next time.  Oh, and we omitted the mushrooms (preference).

Scallops are a family favorite and when they are the size of eggs they are especially filling. Add the other ingredients  and top them off with cheese,  and you will observe a work of art, while your tastebuds quiver "lovealicious". (This is DH's review.)
These did taste just like cake doughnuts.  I will be making more to put in my freezer.  I think I will try making them as a mini doughnut next time and make them bite size yum.

DH (who loves spicy food) had a cold.  I thought that something spicy like this would be just right for him.  It was.

I added cayenne pepper and a little less hot sauce.  A day or two later, I made this with mushrooms instead of chicken for my vegetarian daughter.

I also froze a serving successfully.

These were tasty but not as moist as I like my muffins! Could that be a result of my using 1/2 whole wheat flour & 1/2 all purpose flour? I set my timer for the full 30 minutes but would advise checking them earlier. Thanx Roosie!

Delicious!!!! I used pepperoni cuz that's what I had on hand, and the kids ate them up!!!
I folded mine into little triangles, but just folding the wrappers in half, corner to corner. It made it a little less work for me. I'm going to use these in a cooking class I'm teaching next month!

I divided this into two 9x9 pan servings and froze one for later.  The one left for tonight's summer was prepared solely for my son since I had prior committments.  My son gave this 5 stars - he should know - because he ate 3/4 of it and packed the rest for his lunch for the next day.  I didn't get even one taste of it!  Thanks, Kree, for sharing a great recipe.

These were average.  I thought they were a little bland and needed something else.  I even used garlic powder.  I didn't use enough onions which would have helped, I think.  I was a little concerned about them having too strong of a mustard taste, since my kids don't like mustard, but they didn't at all.  The kids liked them with ketchup.  I'm not sure I will make these again as I have another roasted potato recipe I use all the time.  I was out of some of those ingredients, so that is why I tried this one.  This is not bad by any means, but nothing that screams "make me often."  Thanks for your many wonderful recipes.

These were a hit for my NYE party.  I made them ahead of time and froze them.  I then baked at 350 in my toaster oven for about 12 min.  Make sure you don't over cook them.  The first few test ones I did I over cooked and they were super dry.  I'm definitely adding this to my make ahead and keep on hand in freezer appetizer recipes.
I used a small ham and we had it with garlic pasta. The ham was nice and moist and tasted good. Thanks!

I made this for a New Year's Eve party and everyone raved about it.  I followed the recipe exactly and it came out perfect.  NOTE:  You really need to use fresh, shredded parmesan, not the kind in a canister.  It will not come out the same.  I get mine at Trader Joe's.  I served it with tortilla chips.
Tried this at Christmas and was a little disappointed, nothing wrong with recipe just thought it would have been better. Prefer prezels, white chocolate and m&m's mixed together.
This was deemed "okay" by the family.  It was a different tweak to tater tot hotdish, and I probably won't make it again, as it didn't get the reaction that would put it into the rotation.
I cooked the peppers about 10 minutes. We like them a little soft.  It was so good, it's going on my what's for dinner list!
I made these for my son tonight and he really enjoyed them.  I thought they were pretty good too!  This is such a great easy snack!

Super easy to make and yummy at that. I used potato bread buns and I omitted the tomato paste.  I added alittle onion soup mix to the burgers. Served with swiss cheese and bacon. Was a hit with the kids and DH. Will make again. Thanks for sharing. Made for 123 hits

This is a very good recipe.  I boiled my shrimp heads and shells for the stock and left out the beer, just cause I did not have any.  I chopped my veggies fine and garnished my plate servings with chopped green onion.  Served over rice with steamed veggies in cheese sauce, and garlic bread.  My family was well pleased.  For those who thought the sauce was to thin just cut back  some on the stock until you add the shrimp, because the shrimp release liquid as they cook.  More so with frozen than fresh.  You can add more stock at the end if needed.
Really good chili!! A little sweet for our tastes, next time a little less brown sugar. The spices, beer and coffee were a great change and we really enjoyed the recipe. Thanks so much for posting.
I made this tonight, what wonderful favors. I made "My Very Best Steak or Chicken Fajitas", Recipe #113475. Delicious!

This was a quick and easy dessert to make.  My 7 yr old son helped me and he enjoyed being able to measure the ingredients easily.  We doubled the recipe and used fresh strawberries I needed to get rid of.   It was good - not great - but very good.  It tastes exactly like you think it will.  I would make it again if I had strawberries available but wouldn't probably run out and buy the ingredients just for this!
I found these a bit salty. They were still good, I would make them again, just with less ingredients :)

This was the easiest dinner roll recipe that I have ever made.  The dough firmed up in the fridge after chilling for 24 hours.  I placed in a gallon size ziploc bag and it rose beautifully (slowly) in the fridge. I made 24 rolls which was large enough to fit into a 9 X 13 inch pan.  I let it rise for 2 hours and it was fluffy, full, and rose beautifully.  My guest enjoyed it!
Very good. I only used one summer squash but added some macaroni and probably a bit more cheese. Very good and easy. Thanks for sharing!

You know, I've made this recipe quite a few times since finding it so I figured I should get off my duff and give my review. I love it!- especially crumbled with cream and sugar. I do add the flour as was the recommendation- and sometimes I throw in a pinch of soda, but sometimes not..lol. I cook it in a cast iron skillet and it comes out with that perfect crunch. Thanks so much Red!
The recipe asks for 2 TABLESPOONS of pepper! That's WAY too much. Otherwise the recipe was really good--we substituted GF cream of mushroom soup.

This was really tasty, however I altered it quite a bit.  I added 1 tbsp of both ginger and garlic instead of 1 tsp, added peas, used half tinned tomatoes and some tomato paste like previous commenter, only added half the water, added 2 tsp of cardamon, and increased the other spices.  Served with tumeric rice and it was delicious.  Would be a little bland if I hadn't oomphed up the spices.

This is a great pumpkin bread recipe. I used some leftover baked winter squash instead of canned pumpkin and it turned out super good. I also added a little bit of grated orange peel and juice so it gave it a slight orange flavor which was also nice. I made a sweet cream cheese spread and served it up for breakfast. Huge hit!!!  I plan on taking some to my daughters for Thanksgiving morning breakfast. You know how it is on the morning of a big food prep day......BUSY, BUSY!!  I am planning to make up several pans of this, freezing it and presto......easy, peasy busy morning breakfast . They're gunna love me ---- thanks to you :) Thanks so much for sharing!  You're the best!!!

This is an excellent salad that can be made a day ahead, freeing up time for the rest of the meal whether you are having guests or not.  The dressing is the perfect compliment to this salad.  Thanks for sharing this, Baby Chevelle.

This is the first soup I've ever made, all because my mom sent the hambone home with me. I looked around and found this recipe and it seemed way easier than many of them so it's the one I used. Wow! It's great soup and I love the recipe and will definitely use it again!

Absolutely great! Made this tonight with Franks Red Hot sauce. I lined my baking dish with foil and sprayed it with cooking spray for easier clean-up. Next time I'll double the sauce. Thanks for posting such an easy, tasty recipe!

Made for "Went to the Market"... I fed this to several hungry teenagers, and they loved it! I also used lots of cheese, and I agree- the leftovers are great!! Quick, tasty, and filling... who could ask for more?
Great way to make tilapia with no fishy taste.  My whole family likes this.  Thanks for the recipe!

Excellent appetizer!   I do have to confess that I didn't read the directions correctly, so when I got ready to make the dish realized I was supposed to be doing it from scratch (dry beans).   We had guest coming in three hours so had to use canned beans and it was great!   I didn't have tahini sesame butter, so followed RZ's suggestion for substitution (little peanut butter and sesame oil), and it worked out great!   Thanks for sharing!

My parents dropped in for an overnight visit, leaving me scrambling for breakfast plans.  I found this recipe and am sure glad I did.  It was very simple to make and impressed my mother...a feat all its own.  I did substitute strawberry jam for the raspberry jam, vanilla for the almond extract and chopped pecans for the almonds, due to my ingredients on hand.  It was fantastic! Very rich and moist, it was a perfect complement to a bold cup of coffee.

I really like the deep flavor that beer adds to this recipe.  I used a Miller Genuine Draft(dont know what kind i was supposed to use).  I also made part of the chili with ground chicken. Both kinds(meat and nonmeat) were excellent.  Had a nice thick consistency and deep red color.  Really good!

Great recipe!  I didn't have corn flakes so I used seasoned whole wheat bread crumbs and oops forgot the paprika.  I also used frozen peppers and onions which I added to the cauliflower as I was steaming it.  We really enjoyed this recipe.  I will be adding it to my Easter menu.  Thanks Kittencal!

Pretty good! I think the secret to non-soggy biscuit topping is to put your pepperoni slices on top then add cheese then put the biscuit pieces on top of that. My biscuit pieces didn't get the least bit soggy that way. I'm going to try pizza dough next time, my husband wanted more "crust" too.
The entire family loved this recipe.  Leftovers were fantastic when added to a green salad.

Good recipe.  I liked the addition of the ground cloves.  I marinated the meat for about 1 hour.  Since it was raining outside I used my grill pan and the steak turned out pefectly.  Thank you for the recipe.  Made for Fall PAC 2009.

Wonderful!  This is definitely going into my family's "favorites" file.  I left out the garlic for my garlic-hating husband (I did add in a little garlic powder), only used one pound of ground beef, and only used one 6oz can of tomato paste since that's all I had on hand.  Even with those changes, this was a great sauce.  It smelled so good that we kept tasting it during the day as it cooked.  At supper time, I boiled half a box of macaroni & then stirred it into the crockpot with the sauce for a wonderful "goulash".  I'll be making this again, probably soon.  Thanks for sharing!

I was just going to post this recipe when I saw you had already done so. This is a family favorite that we've been making for at least 15 years. It is a very rich dessert, so a little goes a long way. YUM!
Minus the raisins and currants it was very good. I actually fried in oil in a cast iron pan and it was super yummy. Kids devoured it! Thanks for sharing!
I loved the tart Granny Smith apple with the cheese and turkey! Didnt have plain yogurt so I used sour cream for the dip. This would be a great snack for kids or adults! Thank you toni!

Made about half the recipe (1 fennel bulb, l red pepper, 1 Tbsp capers), and regretted it. These vegetables came out so sweet, and I thought the balsamic vinegar amount was perfect. Contributed to the sweetness but did not end up being too tart. We reduced the oil to about 1/2 tablespoon for half the recipe and we kept this in the oven for 45 minutes and decided it needed 10-15 minutes more. The vegetables held their shape and were nicely charred. We also thought 6 servings was quite generous. The two of us couldn't finish half the recipe even though we had seconds. We served this with a rice side. Really outstanding French Tart, thanks!
Fabulous.  The seafood was perfectly cooked and everyone loved it.  They don't tell you how much seafood to use.  We used a pound of each to serve 6.

Thanks so much for the recipe!  I replaces the Bovril with Kitchen Bouquet and a little beef boullion and it worked fine.  I have missed this soup since they have shut down all the Harrigan's in my area....and well, since we moved out of Texas!  It is such a decadant soup!  Thank you once again!
This is the best way to do a roast of pork that I have ever cooked.  Very moist and great the next day for sandwiches of a salad.

Great recipe.  I used two cloves of garlic and a wok to cook it in.  This keeps the garlic from burning (stir until fragrant).  Next time, I'll add a clove or two before cooking the chicken.  All we had was honey dijon which added a bit of sweetness.  I think a couple of drops of hot sauce (or pepper flakes) and some corn starch thickener will fill the bill!  Thanks.
Oh my wow this was delicious! :D  I absolutely loved having the artichoke hearts and some homegrown tomatoes with our cheese ravioli.  Made for veg*n swap and will be making again!
My husband and I loved this!  I've never had the dish at Cheesecake Factory so I can't compare but this was excellent.  Served with broccoli instead of mashed potatoes.

OMG! This was the best brownie ever. So fudgy, so moist, so good! I made this for a dessert potluck and everyone loved it. They just loved it. It was the only dessert that was finished other than the birthday cake.
I've made an addition of 1/3 C of nutritional yeast which takes this to the next level of deliciousness, great recipe for the colder fall/winter months

I thought this was excellent!  I omitted the sugar/cinnamon dip because I was out of sugar.  Instead, I just made more "drizzle" and dipped each biscuit in there before layering.  It turned out wonderful!  It didn't bake evenly though.  I had to take the top layer out after 20 minutes (convection), then put the rest back in, then take the top layer off again, etc etc.  Next time, I would try to spread them out in a flat pan and hope they would bake more evenly.

Oh boy I loved this!  Easy to put together with delicious results.  I left out the onions because I don't care for them, otherwise made as specified.  I think that a sausage/cheddar or bacon/swiss combination would be great too.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

DELICIOUS!!!  Oh my this was good - very tasty and not what anyone was expecting when they had their first bite. I made 1 3/4 recipe - about 5 cups of sweet potatoes and adjusted accordingly.  My only mess up was putting in too much salt but the recipe didn't suffer.  I told all the SP haters to please try just one bite and all but one LOVED the dish.  I don't like walnuts so used all pecans instead.  The crumb topping was really nice and there was no need for marshmallows.  Our friend's daughter told us how she "hates pecans passionately!!" but loved them on the sweet potatoes. There was lots of second helpings and kuddos on the recipe so this one is a keeper will be made again.

If you've never had Cheesecake Factory you'll love it. If you have, it won't measure up. I also recommend you double the crust ingredients since I didn't and it nearly wasn't enough crust to accommodate all the batter. It does taste better with age, so allow 1-2 days before dipping in. Fluffy and all, but lacked a certain sweetness, creaminess and smoothness Cheesecake Factory Cheesecake has. My guests nor I were really impressed. Hit or miss for me.

Outstanding rolls, and so quick and easy!  I used my stand mixer instead of a food processor.  I was doing chores around the house while making these so each rising time was probably more like 20 minutes instead of 15.  Great recipe - thanks for sharing it!

Best buns ever! Followed the recipe exactly, got awesome soft golden melt-in-your-mouth buns. My kid calls them clouds. Used them for sandwiches, with butter and jam, ate them plain or with just butter or margarine... They would probably make cute little sliders but they don't last that long. Brought two batches at work today, made everyone's Monday better. :) I'm planning to try mixing the ingredients in the Kitchenaid and then letting the dough rise before shaping the rolls and letting them rise a second time - it would be nice if I could make more than 15 at once.

By joop
on October 13, 2010, you said you used only ww pastry flour, but it doesn't have the gluten or the protein that bread flours provide. I think if you use a whole wheat bread flour, or add some vital wheat gluten to your ww pastry flour, then you could make a nice loaf that meets your healthy criteria. I'm using a 7 grain and sunflower millet blend with some ww bread flour and I have had no issues with any of the combinations being dense or not rising. Blessings and good health!

This s a  delicious use of veggies!!  It's just DH and I so I was worried it would make too much, now I'm worried there won't be any left by the time he gets home for dinner!!  I followed all the ingredients as written (I used olive oil)  but I did process the mint and parsley instead of chopping.  Thank you for  posting Lori,  this will  become a regular at our house!!

I wanted oatmeal chocolate chip cookies but didn't want as much fat as normal (and I didn't have that much butter) so this was good.  We enjoyed them.  The texture is not quite what I love about regular oatmeal chocolate chip cookies, but these tasted good and were enjoyed by all!

super easy simple and yummy cake.. everyone loved it. I was a bit scared at the start cuz I didn't wait for the raison and butter mixture to cool down I mixed the dry ingrediants while it was hot, but after it was baked it was fantastic.

I boiled two chicken breasts added salt, garlic powder and tyme. I used store bought pie crusts and baked the bottom for 15 minutes before adding the filing. I also added in some frozen corn and string beans and used skim milk! Still delicious and creamy! Will definitely make again.
I used this recipe for a very big batch for a banquet I'm putting out.  It turned out wonderfully, even with having to use less than ripe bananas.  I recommend this recipe to anyone.
I made these pumpkin bars this afternoon exactly as the recipe stated.  My husband and I thought these were moist and delicious.  This will be a new favorite Thanksgiving Day dessert for our family!

This rating scale is not high enough.  I am lucky enough to personally know the chef.  She is awesome.  I see the recipe, but it must be the chef.  I am willing to camp out in front of the house (for at least 2 nights)if I can have some more of the Spaghetti Bake.  You just don't know.  This is some good stuff.  I am a protein kind of gut, but I am willing to give it up for this.  10 stars is my rating, but I guess we'll have to go with 5 for now.  Cudos to the chef!!!

This was so good.  I just through the chicken in with some pasta when it was warm and with the leftover chicken I made the best salad I've ever eaten-and I don't usually eat salad.

It was super easy to make, I didn't have a few things so I altered it (didn't have fresh onion so used onion powder, didn't have margarm-just left it out).  For the salad i just had lettuce a little rance sauce, carrots and crutons.
I personally think this recipe is lacking something. I did not find it tasty, or yummy , im sorry to say. It's very sweet and definitely missing an ingredient.

These turned out great.  Very simple recipe.  I made a pie plate full of these for my husband and I and another for my parents.  I even froze another 10 to be used at a later time.  My husband had 2nds...and 3rds! (not typical!)  I took the suggestion from another review and put the ricotta filling in a pastry bag for easy filling.  It made it so easy.  Great recipe!!  Will make often!
My husband and I just loved this recipe. I did add a little more water chestnuts and greens onions. Also, I added some sesame seeds to the sauce. It was delicious and we have enough for leftovers!
Great recipe. It just didn't make enough gravy for my family

Wow-Oh-Wow!!!   This is just excellent--and my WHOLE family agrees.

I used frozen (thawed) sugared raspberries and about a cup of diced, canned peaches [it's what I had on hand]--instead of fresh fruit.   The sugary syrup from the berries seeped into the meringue, and gave it a real lovely "bite."

Speaking of meringue---wow!  This is like eating cotton candy--melts in your mouth but crispy a little too!   

KEEPER!   *Made for ZWT 3 May 2007 Australia Dessert*

These potatoes are the greatest!  My husband couldn't stop eating them!  I have made them several times now and each time I watch anxiously while hubby chows down--I am afraid there won't be any leftovers to top with sharp cheese and sour cream for the next day's lunch!!!  This is a keeper!  Thanks for sharing!

Simple, easy, and the end result was very good.  I had a leftover ham steak which I diced.  I put the ingredients into a casserole as instructed then stirred the potatoes around so all the cheese sauce wouldn't be on the top.  I baked as directed...perfect!! I will make this again but will add some salt and pepper for taste.
A very moist and delicious cake - made it for a friend's birthday - everyone at the party raved about it.  Thanks for a terrific recipe.

This cake is very tender and moist. It is a great way to use up those ripe bananas. ***1 cup mashed bananas=2-3 medium bananas***  Also, this is an 8-inch layer cake, so the recipe makes about 12-16 servings. GREAT with cream cheese frosting (8-oz. cream cheese, 1/2 cup butter, 1 lb. powdered sugar, and 1 tsp. vanilla- beat on high until light and fluffy).

These were very good & an easy-fix. I used both sun-dried + garlic w/herbs tortillas & admit to 1 chg. My thinking was that ea wrap would have roughly 1/4 cup cooked onion + 1/4 cup sauce, but only 1 oz grd meat & less than 1 oz cheese. I knew my DH would say "Where is the beef?", so I doubled the grd meat. I know that made them a little less "light", but my grd meat was very lean, DH was happier & next time I will add bulk w/diced bell pepper + mushrooms. I used the microwave rather than oven & got the fold & roll wrong, but DH said he liked these better than spaghetti. Thx for sharing the recipe w/us.

This worked out perfectly in my stand mixer with the paddle attachment. It rose really nicely, is moist and very chocolatey. I made 2 changes - 1) I cooked it for about 20 minutes longer than listed and 2) sprinkled some chopped walnuts on top as my one boy doesn't like nuts and could pick them off. Fabulous and easy bread that I will definitely make again. And again. And again!! Made for Went to the Market tag game. Thanks Dienia B.! :)

Terrific cookies! They rolled out nicely (I refrigerated for between 20 and 30 minutes) and I used a drinking glass to cut out round cookies.  I cooked for between 7 and 8 minutes (depending on how thick a particular batch was) and sprinked with colored sprinkles for Valentine day favors.  Would recommend and will make again!
Great fudge!  I loved the fact that there was no butter, too. Very rich. Will add to my Christmas candy list. Thanks ever so much for sharing!

Absolutely glorious! I have both peppers growing, one red habanero, and one yellow for scotch bonnet. I have a hard time telling the difference, because the whole taste was simply delicious. The shrimp did mellow perfectly in the marinade, not hot at all, just a nice balance of garlic, thyme, allspice and green onion. Don't even be put off by the peppers, because you will be pleasantly surprised. Thanks for sharing such a treat! Made for *Everyday is a Holiday* game. August 2009

I must admit first I have never tried this :)  BUT my husband likes it very much and I have made it many times.  It is nice to be able to change up lunch fo rhim and do soemthing different from the same old sandwiches.  Thank you so much for sharing!

Oops!  I just realized I forgot to review this recipe!  On July 5th I made these using one recipe of Recipe #23565.  Absolutely delicious!  And what fun they were too!  I used an empanada crimper to cut the circles & then fold & crimp them.  To speed up the filling step I stirred the PB & J together in a small bowl & then used a toddler spoon to drop a teaspoon of the mixture in each circle.  We used smooth PB & Blackberry jelly.  Yum!  Thanks for sharing, OhSheila!  Made & enjoyed for Zaar Chef Alphabet tag game.

This was really delicious! To make it a little healthier, I used 93/7% ground turkey and unsweetened almond milk. Tons less calories but super yummy! I didn't see the need to add the extra onion and garlic powder because I added both fresh. Can't wait to make this again!

I'm with Sharon, in that we do love our broccoli, & this is a great new way (for me) to prepare it! I did cut it down to 1/3 the original size, but still used the original amount of raisins & pumpkin seeds, absolutely loving that combo! And for the bacon I used 2 tablespoons of bacon bits! A wonderful tasting salad that I'll have on my table again before long! Thanks for sharing the recipe! [Made & reviewed in Every Day Is a Holiday tag]

Very nice muffin and quite delicious right out of the oven with a bit of spread (I use Smart Balance light).  I did not include the raisins, as I have some lifelong raisin haters in the family.  I also reduced the oil to 1/4 cup and used 1/4 canned pumpkin.  I imagine you could also use baby food prunes or applesauce as well.  Next time I make it I will add some salt (I think it needs maybe 1/4 to 1/2 tsp.  It might also be good with a bit less cinnamon and some giner to make it taste even more like ginerbread.  Thanks for posting--I will make again.  My kids gobbled them up!

Absolutely fabulous and easy recipe. I made no changes to this recipe and it was perfect "as is". The ONLY change I made was to put out shredded cheese and sour cream as well as the crushed tortilla chips for the topping. In the fall and winter my family loves soup and this will be on the menu often as after work I love EASY, so this soup satisfies everyone.
This is an excellent recipe that I found in Taste of Home magazine originally.  I came tonight to post here and found it already here!  Thanks for sharing, Parsley!
I made this for my parents.  It was so easy and it tasted great and I looked like a great cook.  The next day we had pull porked sandwiches.  Will make again and again and again.

Really yummy!!  I will try a little milk in with the soup/sour cream mix next time to give it a little more creamy texture.  My kids loved it!  I didn't have any potato chips on hand so I used french's fried onions and it was fantastic!  Might cut back to 1/2 cup of sour cream next time too...got a little too rich for seconds!!  Overall...outstanding!

I made this recipe but used while wheat flour. I don't think that made it that different however. It wasn't very cheesy in flavor and I don't really like the texture. I was hoping for more of a Velveeta type texture. Thanks for sharing though;).
my husband hates fish but tried it anyway, he loved it ...
These are very, very yummy. I use unflavored rum, and the Pina Colada mix that comes frozen in a can. We enjoyed these at an outdoor wedding luncheon!

A friend of mine served this the other night, this could be served in a fine Italian cafe and fit right in. He did use ground pork as that is what he had and he used cannelloni for the pasta to be stuffed. Other than that he went exactly by the recipe. His father, which doesn't care for cheese or pasta went back for seconds! This is definately going into my cookbooks for future dinners! Thanks, I really liked this.

My children gave this 2 thumbs up (that's great since they are 2 of the fussiest eaters on the face of the planet!)  Very simple, taste great...I undercooked my bacon though,  so it would not burn while in the oven...Turned out great, thanks a bunch!
I tried this recipe out on some family while I was home for my sisters wedding and even the non rhubarb fans thought it was great and wanted to know where to find the recipe.

This is an amazing recipe.  It really is like take out!!  My only problem was having WAY too much sauce.  So next time I will 1/2 that portion of the recipe.  
 Since I'm vegetarian, I made mine with tofu and it still came out great.  I just pan fried mine instead of deep frying.  I also added some freshly squeeze orange juice and zest to  make mine orange-sesame sauce.  SO outrageously delicious!!!  This is a keeper.
Very nice and refreshing.  I loved the combination of the feta, cucumbers and mint.  A very nice side dish - my guests loved it too!

I would call this Corn Bread Delight instead of Creamed Corn Casserole due to the bready texture as opposed to any mushy or soupy textures.  This was very good - don't get me wrong, I just think it isn't named properly.  Corn bread is the main ingredient not creamed corn.  You get more of the bread pudding feel instead of a casserole.  It can be served as a side dish, but know that it is a bit on the sweet side.  It is very yummy and I will make it again!  A dallop of honey adds the right kick too! ;)

Beware the salt! When I made this recipe, I cut the 3 teaspoons of salt down to 1 teaspoon, and I still feel it is a little heavy on the salt. It is a very wonderful light fresh summer salad though. Perfect for a hot summer evening. I made this recipe with some fresh basil from my garden. Besides cutting the salt down, I made a couple other modifications-I added garlic to the oil, and I added a small quartered sliced zucchini, raw. I also zested the lemon, to get some of the extra flavor and nutrients from the peel. It was delicious! A very versatile recipe. It could be made as is (aside from the salt), or add what ever additional ingredients you have in the garden or fridge, to spice it up.
I didn't care for the brown sugar in this. I couldn't taste that beefy flavor I'm used to in my gravies. I will try this again without the brown sugar.
Love this recipe, have made them twice in the last week. used it for my daughters 2nd birthday party..everyone loved them too .
Very good recipe!!  Picky DH and 16-mo old baby loved it!!  We only marinated for 30 minutes but it was still full of flavor.  Quick and tasty!

This was the first time that I've attempted to make cookies with Tahini (I found it by "krinos" in a jar and it's sesame seeds ground into a paste). After much experimentation I was successful when I formed the "dough" into medium-sized balls, flattened them while they were on the baking sheet, put them into a pre-heated 300 degree oven for 8 minutes and let cool for 20 minutes. I think they are a delicious cookie for those that crave sweets and are unable or avoiding consuming wheat products. Don't give up if your first batch isn't what you expect.....the end result is worth the effort!  I made this for ZaarTag.
This soup is right up my alley, I simply loved it! I made this with no changes which is something rare for me, I can't wait to make this again soon, thanks Kel!...Kitten:)
Easy, fast & delicious!  I only had about 1 hour to marinate this but the flavors were all there!!  I sauteed these in my cast iron skillet & they were perfect.  Thank you!

We LOVED this.  I used Emeril's kicked up tomato and garlic sauces and it was just the right amount of spice.  We're a family of 4 with a 6 yr old and a 3 yr old and we ate 1/2 of this.  Ziti is hard to find though!
This is a really good weeknight recipe that everyone enjoys, including the picky eaters in my family. I add carrots for colour and double the sauce.

Super yummy, super easy! Step 5, "pour wine over fish" is not necessary. It will wash all the rub away. I added about two tablespoons of white wine vinegar to the rub (just enough to make it easier to spread) and then used a silicone brush to brush on all sides of the fillets. There was leftover rub. For the last five minutes I drizzled some of the remaining rub on the fillets and then poured what was leftover into the baking dish. I sprinkled the Italian seasoning on each fillet and baked for 5 minutes. It was PERFECT!!! My husband, Mom-In-Law and I all enjoyed every bite!!! Can't wait to make again!!! Soooo easy and soooo delicious!!! Enjoy...

Very easy to make and pretty tasty!  I made it for my Sunday crockpot meal and it ended up cooking on low for about 5 hours, but was perfect!  The only changes I made were that I used cooking sauce as opposed to enchilada sauce and I used flour tortillas instead of corn.  Thanks for posting, PPM!

This was a super easy dish. I recently started a meal exchange with a group of friends (so I had to make 6) and this was my first choice. It was so simple, I felt I was cheating!  Thanks. Can't wait to hear the reviews from friends!
There was once an Orange Julias place in the mall near our house. It isn't there any more. But now I can make my own! Thank you!!

This was very easy to make and baked up great with no cracking.  The kids liked it and they ate it all.  While I like brownies and I like pumpkin cheesecake, I don't think the flavors really work together.  I am glad I tried this, but I think this would be better with a plain or vanilla cheesecake top layer instead of the pumpkin.

I found this on the recipezaar website two years ago and have being making it ever since. I cook it on the stove for 1 1/2 to 2 hours and add 2 to 3 tablespoons of lemon juice. We love it with crusty bread and aged yellow cheese (e.g. romano, parmasan)

I seriously had my doubts about this pie but my curiousity got the better of me--and I am so glad it did!  What a great pie this is!  I used Splenda Brown Sugar Blend both in the pie and in the topping.  I also added some freshly grated nutmeg to both filling and topping--we really like nutmeg with pears.   I used 3 huge Anjou pears.  After reading the previous reviewer's comments, I brushed the pie shell with a lightly beaten egg and pre- baked the shell for about 8 minutes, this seems to have prevented the crust from being soggy.

Sice the kids last day of school was today, I thought this would be a perfect fit, for them to help.  It was a SMASHING  hit with them.  They didn't bother on having a sandwich.  Made recipe as posted  but skipped step #13 though.  A definatre kid pleaser.  Made for New Zaar tag.

Yum, we made these for our game day party and they were a hit.  I made both roast beef and turkey.  Our favorite was the beef as it seemed to pair best with the dressing.  But still both really good.  Thank you for sharing this recipe withus.

Absolutely delicious!  I made this for my husband and myself for a weeknight meal but it is definitely a meal worthy to serve at a dinner party.  I could have just eaten the sauce and left the meat, that's how good it is!

I used salted butter and light brown sugar as that was what I had on hand. I also added 1 tsp cinnamon. The cookies were great! My mother even reconsidered her position on this type of cookie, she usually doesn't care for them. The BIG bowl of the finished product was gone the next day, so I think the kids agreed. As a variation, I made bars with the same recipe, adding 2 medium, chopped granny smith apples and baking for about 30 minutes. Everone was similarly appreciative of these.

I only tried this, after worrying about the amount of yeast required (3 1/2 tablespoons! and I cut that down to an even 3...), because some of the comments indicated that the bread didn't taste "yeasty".  Wrong.  I baked until it was quite brown on the bottom, almost 20 minutes, and the taste of yeast was overpowering.  A waste of my time, and now I have to find another type of bread to serve with my Noth-African-themed dinner next weekend.

This was my first attempt at Scotcharoos, and for my husband's 5-year high school none-the-less!  They were WONDERFUL!!!  So easy and so good, loved the extra peanut butter as compared to other recipes.  I did use about 8 ounces each of the chips, I love chocolate!  This was a complete success...my husband is already asking for more!
This was very good.  I had a 3.5lb roast and it only took 2 hours but turned out great.  I also like that you told us what you served it with.  Thank you

These are great!  Fluffy and sweet and I liked the vanilla flavor.  I topped mine with strawberry preserves and really enjoyed this breakfast treat - thanks for posting the recipe!  Made for Spring PAC 2009
Delicious and extremely easy! I also like that it's not deep fried so it's low fat. Thanks for posting such a great recipe!

A great simple way to prepare chicken.   At the last minute I threw this together and actually prepared on stove top cause I didn't have an hour to bake and it still turned out great using boneless chicken but think the oven is the way to go.
